newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CHINESE MAN KILLED IN BUDAPEST AFTER BOMB MURDERS.
newsitem.headline: CHINESE MAN KILLED IN BUDAPEST AFTER BOMB MURDERS.

text.p: The corpse of a Chinese man, beaten to death, was found in a Budapest flat on Saturday, one week after a hand grenade attack killed two Chinese women in the city, the Hungarian Television said.
Police said there was no evidence neither for that the two murders were connected, nor that the latest case was part of a gang war.
"It is too early to suppose anything," a police official told the television.

However, the case may be important as the police chief of Budapest appeared on the spot, the television said, adding that a pistol with a silencer was found lying near the corpse and Chinese people living in the same block of flats were questioned by the police.
A hand grenade explosion in a popular Chinese restaurant in Budapest one week ago killed the owner's wife and daughter in the deadliest in a spate of bombings in the Hungarian capital.

The gang war killed at least three people and damaged almost two dozen car showrooms, restaurants, pubs, nightclubs or peep shows have been damaged since September by hand grenades or petrol-filled bombs.
Hungary's new national police chief, Attila Berta, told Hungarian radio earlier this week that he expected further attacks linked to what he called a "mafia war".
